chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Alaa ibn Rasin, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Allah created the Will on its own (by itself). Then He created the things through (the intermediacy of) the Will.
ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between God's Will and the creation of the universe in Shia theology?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi elucidates the divine attribute of Will (al-Mashi'ah), asserting that God created His Will as an independent entity prior to the creation of all other things, thereby establishing volition as the primary mechanism of existence. In Shia theological discourse, this underscores the pre-eminence of divine intent over material causality, distinguishing God's eternal will from created acts. It reinforces the concept that the universe is brought into being solely through the deliberate and independent exercise of God's will.
